test.text: Navigate to the page and confirm the landmark "main" is announced before the heading.
Tab to the heading and ensure focus lands within the <main> landmark.

steps: Wrap the heading and its content in a <main> element.
Ensure the <main> is the only landmark of its type on the page.
Verify the landmark is announced by screen readers.

content.explanation: The heading is not inside a landmark, so screen‑reader users can’t quickly navigate the page. Wrap the content in a landmark such as <main>.

verification.note: This rule depends on the whole page, so a lone snippet can't be re-checked. Re-scan after applying it.
